Hi Pree, I haven't saved the draft yet. Even with you owning the account, a per-seat rate can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner. Anyone else, Tobias included, needs Anselm or June to approve it first. That holds even for a draft you'd send yourself, because the draft would be addressed to him.

I've messaged June to ask for her approval to the draft to Tobias, subject "Tansley 2027 rate", with the $1,313-per-seat proposed 2027 rate for the planning sheet. I didn't include the figure in my message to her. Once she or Anselm says yes, I'll save the draft in your mailbox for you to send. If you'd rather ask Anselm directly, that works too.
